verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs confirm that Git Large File Storage is available, but only when enabled and with Git >= 2.1.2, and this single conditional line is the only evidence. Missing for 10: detail on LFS configuration and storage backends, how LFS objects are handled in the UI or API, file size or quota limits, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store large binary files with Git LFS

citations.quote: Git Large File Storage will be available if enabled and if your Git version is >= 2.1.2
